predecessors.name: Dutch Suriname
predecessors.text: Dutch Suriname, from 1954 a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, independent on 25 November 1975 (the dutch-suriname dossier dissolves on that date with this state as counterpart)

ledger.x: 25 November 1975: Suriname becomes independent from the Netherlands.
25 February 1980: a military coup overthrows Arron's government, led by Dési Bouterse; same state, same land.

wars.name: Suriname Interior War (Maroon rebellion)
wars.outcome: The page says only that the civil war 'begun in 1986, continued' and gives no end date or territorial result.
